title: BITMINE IMMERSION TECHNOLOGIES, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-07
summary: BitMine Immersion Technologies, Inc. (NYSE American: BMNR) filed an 8-K on April 7, 2026 disclosing amendments to the employment agreements of its CEO (Chi Tsang) and CFO/COO (Young Kim), both dated April 2, 2026. The amendments modify long-term incentive compensation structures for each executive. This filing has no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: CEO Chi Tsang's amended agreement provides an annual long-term incentive target of $500,000, delivered 60% as RSUs and 40% as stock options.
CFO/COO Young Kim's amended agreement provides an annual long-term incentive target of $1,750,000, delivered entirely as stock options; FY2026 award will be prorated.
Both award tranches vest in four equal quarterly installments of 25% over one year, subject to continued employment.
Award quantities are determined using a 10-day volume-weighted average trading price ending the day before the grant date; options are multiplied by a factor of three.
The filing was signed by CEO Chi Tsang on April 7, 2026.
